name: Shoreline Strix

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You're the descendant of strix who traveled to the coasts. Your feathers are especially water-repellent and sleekly angled for diving, allowing you to catch fish and other prey in the shallows. You are trained in Athletics, and you gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat as a bonus skill feat.
